observations.result: All History lessons 1–34 occupy their own pages 13–46 in the contact-sheet overview. The individual inspections of pages 17, 36 and 46 confirm intact endings with room above the footer.
Cover lettering is legible and contained. Title-page sparsity is deliberate. The edition/copyright page fits without clipped text; the long commit identifier wraps within the text block.
Individually inspected pages 4 and 5 have consistent leaders, aligned page numbers, and adequate separation from the footer. Remaining contents pages 6–9 show orderly alignment in the contact sheets.
Pages 10 and 11 form a substantial two-page introduction. The page break occurs between paragraphs; page 11 is neither a tiny spill nor an orphaned closing line.

Lesson labels, headings, body spacing and endnote markers are consistent across the individual lesson pages. Long headings wrap without overlap. The longest History lesson by word count, page 36, fits comfortably.
Part I on page 12 and Part II on page 47 use matching sparse opening designs. Page 46 closes History cleanly; page 48 starts Science on its own page.
The running book label, thin rule and page numbers align consistently on individually inspected text pages. Cover/title presentation is intentionally different.

limitations: Only pages explicitly listed under individual_pages_inspected received an individual-page visual inspection; the other pages in 1–48 were reviewed only as contact-sheet thumbnails.

Individual images are supplied 480 × 720 pixel PNGs, not a high-resolution print proof. The review can identify layout defects at that scale but does not certify every fine glyph or print-color detail.
Pages 49–142 are outside this agent’s review scope. Link destination/functionality and EPUB behavior were not assessed by this visual pass.
